audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim final tribal blessing of Moses, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Sinai/Seir/Paran theophany, Torah inheritance, Jeshurun kingship, tribal blessings from Reuben through Asher, Levi's vocation, Joseph abundance, warrior imagery, tribal omissions, and final praise of Israel's help and refuge.

verses.restored: This is blessing with which Moses, man of Divine, blessed children of Israel before his death.

familiar.text: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

modern.text: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced upon the Israelites before his death.

original.text: וְזֹ֣את הַבְּרָכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בֵּרַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לִפְנֵ֖י מוֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He said: YHWH came from Sinai and dawned from Seir upon them; he shone from Mount Paran and came from holy myriads; from his right hand was fiery law/fire of decree for them.

familiar.text: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.

modern.text: He said: “The LORD came from Sinai and dawned upon us from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran and came with myriads of holy ones, with flaming fire at His right hand.

original.text: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה מִסִּינַ֥י בָּא֙ וְזָרַ֤ח מִשֵּׂעִיר֙ לָ֔מוֹ הוֹפִ֨יעַ֙ מֵהַ֣ר פָּארָ֔ן וְאָתָ֖ה מֵרִבְבֹ֣ת קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִֽימִינ֕וֹ אשדת לָֽמוֹ

verses.restored: Indeed he loves peoples/tribes; all his holy ones are in your hand. They sat down at your feet; each receives from your words.

familiar.text: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.

modern.text: Surely You love the people; all the holy ones are in Your hand, and they sit down at Your feet; each receives Your words—

original.text: אַ֚ף חֹבֵ֣ב עַמִּ֔ים כָּל קְדֹשָׁ֖יו בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְהֵם֙ תֻּכּ֣וּ לְרַגְלֶ֔ךָ יִשָּׂ֖א מִדַּבְּרֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Moses commanded us Torah/instruction, an inheritance for assembly of Jacob.

familiar.text: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

modern.text: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.

original.text: תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה לָ֖נוּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַעֲקֹֽב

verses.restored: He was king in Jeshurun when heads of people assembled, together tribes of Israel.

familiar.text: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

modern.text: So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered, when the tribes of Israel came together.

original.text: וַיְהִ֥י בִישֻׁר֖וּן מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם יַ֖חַד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: May Reuben live and not die, though his men be few/not few.

familiar.text: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.

modern.text: Let Reuben live and not die, nor his men be few.”

original.text: יְחִ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן וְאַל יָמֹ֑ת וִיהִ֥י מְתָ֖יו מִסְפָּֽר

verses.restored: And this for Judah. He said: Hear, YHWH, voice of Judah and bring him to his people. His hands contend for him; be help against his adversaries.

familiar.text: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.

modern.text: And concerning Judah he said: “O LORD, hear the cry of Judah and bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause, but may You be a help against his foes.”

original.text: וְזֹ֣את לִֽיהוּדָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ שְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ ק֣וֹל יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל עַמּ֖וֹ תְּבִיאֶ֑נּוּ יָדָיו֙ רָ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְעֵ֥זֶר מִצָּרָ֖יו תִּהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Of Levi he said: Your Thummim and your Urim belong to your faithful one, whom you tested at Massah, with whom you contended at waters of Meribah,

familiar.text: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

modern.text: Concerning Levi he said: “Give Your Thummim to Levi and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah and contested at the waters of Meribah.

original.text: וּלְלֵוִ֣י אָמַ֔ר תֻּמֶּ֥יךָ וְאוּרֶ֖יךָ לְאִ֣ישׁ חֲסִידֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִסִּיתוֹ֙ בְּמַסָּ֔ה תְּרִיבֵ֖הוּ עַל מֵ֥י מְרִיבָֽה

verses.restored: who said of his father and mother, I have not seen them, and did not recognize his brothers, and did not know his children; for they kept your word and guarded your covenant.

familiar.text: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

modern.text: He said of his father and mother, ‘I do not consider them.’ He disregarded his brothers and did not know his own sons, for he kept Your word and maintained Your covenant.

original.text: הָאֹמֵ֞ר לְאָבִ֤יו וּלְאִמּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִ֔יו וְאֶת אֶחָיו֙ לֹ֣א הִכִּ֔יר וְאֶת בנו לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע כִּ֤י שָֽׁמְרוּ֙ אִמְרָתֶ֔ךָ וּבְרִֽיתְךָ֖ יִנְצֹֽרוּ

verses.restored: They shall teach your judgments to Jacob and your Torah to Israel; they shall put incense before your nose and whole burnt offering upon your altar.

familiar.text: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

modern.text: He will teach Your ordinances to Jacob and Your law to Israel; he will set incense before You and whole burnt offerings on Your altar.

original.text: יוֹר֤וּ מִשְׁפָּטֶ֨יךָ֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב וְתוֹרָתְךָ֖ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יָשִׂ֤ימוּ קְטוֹרָה֙ בְּאַפֶּ֔ךָ וְכָלִ֖יל עַֽל מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Bless, YHWH, his strength/resources, and accept work of his hands. Shatter loins of those rising against him and those hating him, so they rise no more.

familiar.text: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

modern.text: Bless his substance, O LORD, and accept the work of his hands. Smash the loins of those who rise against him, and of his foes so they can rise no more.”

original.text: בָּרֵ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ חֵיל֔וֹ וּפֹ֥עַל יָדָ֖יו תִּרְצֶ֑ה מְחַ֨ץ מָתְנַ֧יִם קָמָ֛יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֖יו מִן יְקוּמֽוּן

verses.restored: Of Benjamin he said: Beloved of YHWH, he dwells securely beside him; he shields him all day, and between his shoulders he dwells.

familiar.text: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

modern.text: Concerning Benjamin he said: “May the beloved of the LORD rest secure in Him; God shields him all day long, and upon His shoulders he rests.”

original.text: לְבִנְיָמִ֣ן אָמַ֔ר יְדִ֣יד יְהֹוָ֔ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶ֖טַח עָלָ֑יו חֹפֵ֤ף עָלָיו֙ כָּל הַיּ֔וֹם וּבֵ֥ין כְּתֵיפָ֖יו שָׁכֵֽן

verses.restored: Of Joseph he said: Blessed by YHWH is his land, with precious gifts of heavens, with dew, and with deep lying beneath,

familiar.text: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

modern.text: Concerning Joseph he said: “May his land be blessed by the LORD with the precious dew from heaven above and the deep waters that lie beneath,

original.text: וּלְיוֹסֵ֣ף אָמַ֔ר מְבֹרֶ֥כֶת יְהֹוָ֖ה אַרְצ֑וֹ מִמֶּ֤גֶד שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִטָּ֔ל וּמִתְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֥צֶת תָּֽחַת

verses.restored: with precious produce of sun and precious yield of moons,

familiar.text: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

modern.text: with the bountiful harvest from the sun and the abundant yield of the seasons,

original.text: וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד תְּבוּאֹ֣ת שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד גֶּ֥רֶשׁ יְרָחִֽים

verses.restored: with finest from ancient mountains and precious things of age-long hills,

familiar.text: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

modern.text: with the best of the ancient mountains and the bounty of the everlasting hills,

original.text: וּמֵרֹ֖אשׁ הַרְרֵי קֶ֑דֶם וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד גִּבְע֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: with precious things of earth and its fullness, and favor of the one dwelling in bush. May it come upon head of Joseph and crown of one set apart from his brothers.

familiar.text: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

modern.text: with the choice gifts of the land and everything in it, and with the favor of Him who dwelt in the burning bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph and crown the brow of the prince of his brothers.

original.text: וּמִמֶּ֗גֶד אֶ֚רֶץ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ וּרְצ֥וֹן שֹׁכְנִ֖י סְנֶ֑ה תָּב֨וֹאתָה֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּלְקָדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽיו

verses.restored: Firstborn of his bull—majesty is his; horns of wild ox are his horns. With them he gores peoples together to ends of earth. They are myriads of Ephraim, and they are thousands of Manasseh.

familiar.text: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

modern.text: His majesty is like a firstborn bull, and his horns are like those of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even to the ends of the earth. Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh.”

original.text: בְּכ֨וֹר שׁוֹר֜וֹ הָדָ֣ר ל֗וֹ וְקַרְנֵ֤י רְאֵם֙ קַרְנָ֔יו בָּהֶ֗ם עַמִּ֛ים יְנַגַּ֥ח יַחְדָּ֖ו אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְהֵם֙ רִבְב֣וֹת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְהֵ֖ם אַלְפֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה

verses.restored: Of Zebulun he said: Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar, in your tents.

familiar.text: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

modern.text: Concerning Zebulun he said: “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your journeys, and Issachar, in your tents.

original.text: וְלִזְבוּלֻ֣ן אָמַ֔ר שְׂמַ֥ח זְבוּלֻ֖ן בְּצֵאתֶ֑ךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר בְּאֹהָלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Peoples they shall call to mountain; there they shall sacrifice sacrifices of righteousness, for abundance of seas they shall suck and hidden treasures of sand.

familiar.text: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.

modern.text: They will call the peoples to a mountain; there they will offer sacrifices of righteousness. For they will feast on the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand.”

original.text: עַמִּים֙ הַר יִקְרָ֔אוּ שָׁ֖ם יִזְבְּח֣וּ זִבְחֵי צֶ֑דֶק כִּ֣י שֶׁ֤פַע יַמִּים֙ יִינָ֔קוּ וּשְׂפוּנֵ֖י טְמ֥וּנֵי חֽוֹל

verses.restored: Of Gad he said: Blessed is one enlarging Gad. Like lioness he dwells and tears arm, even crown of head.

familiar.text: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

modern.text: Concerning Gad he said: “Blessed is he who enlarges the domain of Gad! He lies down like a lion and tears off an arm or a head.

original.text: וּלְגָ֣ד אָמַ֔ר בָּר֖וּךְ מַרְחִ֣יב גָּ֑ד כְּלָבִ֣יא שָׁכֵ֔ן וְטָרַ֥ף זְר֖וֹעַ אַף קָדְקֹֽד

verses.restored: He saw first portion for himself, for there a ruler's portion was reserved; he came with heads of people. Justice of YHWH he did and his judgments with Israel.

familiar.text: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.

modern.text: He chose the best land for himself, because a ruler’s portion was reserved for him there. He came with the leaders of the people; he administered the LORD’s justice and His ordinances for Israel.”

original.text: וַיַּ֤רְא רֵאשִׁית֙ ל֔וֹ כִּי שָׁ֛ם חֶלְקַ֥ת מְחֹקֵ֖ק סָפ֑וּן וַיֵּתֵא֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם צִדְקַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו עִם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Of Dan he said: Dan is lion cub leaping from Bashan.

familiar.text: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

modern.text: Concerning Dan he said: “Dan is a lion’s cub, leaping out of Bashan.”

original.text: וּלְדָ֣ן אָמַ֔ר דָּ֖ן גּ֣וּר אַרְיֵ֑ה יְזַנֵּ֖ק מִן הַבָּשָֽׁן

verses.restored: Of Naphtali he said: Naphtali, satisfied with favor and full of blessing of YHWH, possess west/sea and south.

familiar.text: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.

modern.text: Concerning Naphtali he said: “Naphtali is abounding with favor, full of the blessing of the LORD; he shall take possession of the sea and the south.”

original.text: וּלְנַפְתָּלִ֣י אָמַ֔ר נַפְתָּלִי֙ שְׂבַ֣ע רָצ֔וֹן וּמָלֵ֖א בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה יָ֥ם וְדָר֖וֹם יְרָֽשָׁה

verses.restored: Of Asher he said: Blessed above sons is Asher; may he be favored by his brothers and dip his foot in oil.

familiar.text: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

modern.text: And concerning Asher he said: “May Asher be the most blessed of sons; may he be the most favored among his brothers and dip his foot in oil.

original.text: וּלְאָשֵׁ֣ר אָמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ מִבָּנִ֖ים אָשֵׁ֑ר יְהִ֤י רְצוּי֙ אֶחָ֔יו וְטֹבֵ֥ל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן רַגְלֽוֹ

verses.restored: Iron and bronze are your bars/sandals, and as your days, so your strength/rest.

familiar.text: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.

modern.text: May the bolts of your gate be iron and bronze, and may your strength match your days.”

original.text: בַּרְזֶ֥ל וּנְחֹ֖שֶׁת מִנְעָלֶ֑יךָ וּכְיָמֶ֖יךָ דָּבְאֶֽךָ

verses.restored: There is none like Divine of Jeshurun, riding heavens as your help and clouds in his majesty.

familiar.text: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.

modern.text: “There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.

original.text: אֵ֥ין כָּאֵ֖ל יְשֻׁר֑וּן רֹכֵ֤ב שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ בְעֶזְרֶ֔ךָ וּבְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ שְׁחָקִֽים

verses.restored: The eternal Divine is refuge, and underneath are everlasting arms. He drove enemy from before you and said, Destroy.

familiar.text: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

modern.text: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’

original.text: מְעֹנָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי קֶ֔דֶם וּמִתַּ֖חַת זְרֹעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וַיְגָ֧רֶשׁ מִפָּנֶ֛יךָ אוֹיֵ֖ב וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַשְׁמֵֽד

verses.restored: Israel dwells securely, alone; spring of Jacob in land of grain and new wine, and his heavens drop dew.

familiar.text: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

modern.text: So Israel dwells securely; the fountain of Jacob lives untroubled in a land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בֶּ֤טַח בָּדָד֙ עֵ֣ין יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ דָּגָ֣ן וְתִיר֑וֹשׁ אַף שָׁמָ֖יו יַֽעַרְפוּ טָֽל

verses.restored: Happy are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by YHWH, shield of your help and sword of your majesty? Your enemies shall cringe before you, and you shall tread upon their high places.

familiar.text: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.

modern.text: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is the shield that protects you, the sword in which you boast. Your enemies will cower before you, and you shall trample their high places.”

original.text: אַשְׁרֶ֨יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל מִ֣י כָמ֗וֹךָ עַ֚ם נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּֽיהוָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן עֶזְרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲשֶׁר חֶ֖רֶב גַּאֲוָתֶ֑ךָ וְיִכָּֽחֲשׁ֤וּ אֹיְבֶ֨יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ וְאַתָּ֖ה עַל בָּמוֹתֵ֥ימוֹ תִדְרֹֽךְ

translation_notes: Verse 2 contains difficult and ancient wording, especially eshdat/fiery law, and requires textual-witness audit rather than overconfident harmonization.
Verse 3 may refer to peoples, tribes, or holy ones; its syntax is compressed and uncertain.
Verse 6 has an ambiguity concerning whether Reuben's men are few or not few.
Simeon receives no separate blessing in this chapter, a significant tribal omission requiring literary and historical audit.
Levi's blessing praises radical covenant allegiance and teaching vocation, but verse 9 must not be used to demand family abandonment or clerical cruelty.
Joseph's blessing celebrates ecological abundance—dew, deep waters, sun, seasons, mountains, earth, and fullness.
Wild-ox, lion, goring, shattering, sword, and enemy-destruction images are ancient tribal-war rhetoric and must not authorize modern violence or ethnic domination.
The final refuge image—everlasting arms beneath Israel—must not be superseded or reassigned away from Jewish covenant continuity.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 33 to justify tribal supremacy, family abandonment, clerical violence, conquest, ethnic domination, or supersessionism. Receive the blessing as a diverse, textually difficult tribal poem whose strongest enduring images are Torah as inheritance, land abundance, secure dwelling, Divine refuge, and everlasting arms beneath the people.
